workflows.title: Integration interface obligations
workflows.decision: Review endpoint meanings and transient ownership/completion obligations using connected ports, source contracts and native events.
intent_questions: What do request receipt, completion, cancellation and ownership transfer mean to both sides of this interface?
Which actual elaborated endpoints, clocks, polarity and event histories implement each independent obligation?

evidence_roles.meaning: Original independently required behavior, objective or acceptance contract
Actual selected revision, configuration, mode and native tool/model basis
Original native observations and outcomes for the selected engineering question
Source-backed logical-to-native entity and population relationships

revalidate_when: Original requirement, applicability, exclusion rationale or receiving decision changes
Selected native entity, source, configuration, mode, tool/model version or extraction method changes
A dependent relationship or observation premise is changed, missing or contradicted

workflows.title: Protocol transition and completion obligations
workflows.decision: Review protocol transition and completion obligations through existing correction, handoff and revalidation.
intent_questions: Which distinct participants, ownership rights, data and completion obligations must precede the accepted transition?
Which native identity/epoch-tagged receipts and actual old/new permissions show that each obligation was discharged?
